name: takio
description: A lightweight native desktop, TUI, and CLI alternative to Calibre

scripts.build: bash scripts/check-rust-workspace.sh build && bun run --filter '@takio/core' build && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' build && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' build && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' build
scripts.check: bash scripts/check-rust-workspace.sh check && bun run --filter '@takio/core' check && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' check && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' check && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' check
scripts.test: bash scripts/check-rust-workspace.sh test && bun run --filter '@takio/core' test && bun run --filter '@takio/epub-transform' test && bun run --filter '@takio/library-contract' test && bun run --filter '@takio/library-store-bun' test
scripts.desktop:check: cargo clippy -p takio-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p takio-desktop
